nodes.description: Foundation Phase (Grades R-3)

nodes.title: Grade 2
nodes.description: Grade 2

nodes.title: English First Additional Language
nodes.description: English First Additional Language for Grade 2 — Foundation Phase CAPS. Skills: Listening and Speaking (Mon/Wed/Fri), Phonics (Mon/Wed/Fri), Shared Reading (Tue/Thu) and Group Guided Reading (Mon-Fri daily), Writing (Tue/Thu)

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 2 English FAL Term 1 (45 days). Themes: Consolidation/baseline assessment (Weeks 1-6), Celebrating birthdays (Weeks 7-8), Getting around — different kinds of transportation (Weeks 9-10)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 2 EFAL ATP Term 1

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Mon/Wed/Fri: greeting routine (Hello/Good morning/How are you?/Nice to meet you/How old are you?/What day is it?); songs and rhymes; open-ended question; vocabulary 4 words/day from Week 3. Vocabulary: names/same/different; birthday/celebrate/cake/balloon/candle/present/surprise/party; wish/gift/invite/yummy; drive/car/bus/taxi/fly/airplane/motorcycle/boat/bike

metadata.capsReference: Listening and Speaking: greeting dialogues, birthday, transport vocabulary

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Mon/Wed/Fri: baseline assessment on Grade 1 sounds; identify all single letter sounds; distinguish between different sounds aurally; -at words (cat/mat/fat/sat/pat); -an words (pan/fan/can/man/ran/van); -e words (ten/pen/hen/pet/get/red); -i words (sit/fit/lid/tin/pin); -o words (lot/rot/top/cot/hot); -u words (fun/run/nut/bun); segmenting and blending throughout

metadata.capsReference: Phonics: baseline, CVC families -at -an -e -i -o -u, segmenting/blending

nodes.title: Reading — Shared Reading
nodes.description: Shared Reading on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Cycle: Tue Pre-read (predict) → Thu First Read → following Tue Second Read → following Thu Post-read (recount/act out). Develops comprehension, print concepts and story understanding

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared Reading Tue/Thu, predict, recount

nodes.title: Reading — Group Guided Reading
nodes.description: Group Guided Reading Mon-Fri daily. Baseline assessment to determine 5 reading groups (Group 1: no letter-sound recognition; Group 2: few common words; Group 3: some words, needs help decoding; Group 4: many common words, occasional help; Group 5: fluent, independent reader). Teacher listens to one group per day

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Group Guided Reading — 5 groups, daily sessions

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Tue/Thu: baseline assessment on language structures and creative writing; drawing + caption; writing frames (I am a.../I want to drive.../I feel...); teacher models writing on board first

metadata.capsReference: Writing: baseline, drawing + caption, simple writing frames

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 2 English FAL Term 2 (51 days). Themes: Helping friends (Weeks 1-2), Setting goals (Weeks 3-4), We have feelings (Weeks 5-6), Making mistakes (Weeks 7-8), Being safe and responsible (Weeks 9-10)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 2 EFAL ATP Term 2

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Mon/Wed/Fri: greeting + song/rhyme + open-ended question + vocabulary. Songs: The more we get together, If you want to be a friend, Always try your best, Have a dream set a goal, I have feelings so do you, I make mistakes all the time, I've got a special secret. Vocabulary: friendship/kind/helpful/swing/slide/pretend; goal/achieve/improve/practise/proud; feelings/grumpy/anxious/disappointed; mistake/apologise/careful; responsible/safe/unsafe/frightened

metadata.capsReference: Listening and Speaking: friendship, goals, feelings, mistakes, safety

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Mon/Wed/Fri: revision of -y word endings (shy/try/fly/sky/sly/why/dry/by/my); -s endings (ties/pie-pies/die-dies/lie-lies); -ed endings (asked/baked); -ing endings (walking/baking/cooking/singing/writing/barking); long/short vowel sound distinction; words ending -ed and -ing revision

metadata.capsReference: Phonics: -y endings, -s plurals, -ed endings, -ing endings

nodes.title: Reading — Shared Reading
nodes.description: Shared Reading on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Same cycle as Term 1: Pre-read → First Read → Second Read → Post-read (recount/act out). Increasing comprehension depth and vocabulary in context

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared Reading Tue/Thu

nodes.title: Reading — Group Guided Reading
nodes.description: Group Guided Reading Mon-Fri daily. Revise groups if needed. Teacher listens to one group per day. Reads aloud with teacher using phonics, context clues and sight words. Builds fluency and word attacking skills

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Group Guided Reading — 5 groups, daily sessions

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Tue/Thu: writing frames progressing to short paragraphs. Frames: My friend is.../He/she is.../We like to...; I helped my friend.../I felt...; My goal is.../I will achieve by...; I feel happy when.../I feel grumpy when...; Once I.../Then.../Next time I will...; I feel safe when.../I am responsible when I...

metadata.capsReference: Writing: themed frames, friendship, goals, feelings, safety

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 2 English FAL Term 3 (52 days). Themes: Traditions (Weeks 1-2), Community (Weeks 3-4), Creative thinking (Weeks 5-6), Healthy eating (Weeks 7-8), Worried and afraid (Weeks 9-10)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 2 EFAL ATP Term 3

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Mon/Wed/Fri: greeting + song/rhyme + open-ended question + vocabulary. Songs: Stone Soup (lyrics with actions — shimmy/make circles/rub hands/bubbling in pot/getting nice and hot). Vocabulary: slaughter/animal/celebration/tradition/song/dance/culture/clay; church/mosque/religion/pray/scratch/holidays/celebrate/jewellery; town/city/village/community/school/church/shop/helpful/teacher/farmer/herder; soup/ingredient/stir/trick/villagers/plan/thin/sneaky/clever; creative/idea/old/newspaper/handbag/packet/toy/make/search; recycle/trash/bin/string/problem/solution/wear/necklace/music; healthy/unhealthy/snack/treat/protein/meat/eggs/peanuts/focus; kitchen/cabinet/delicious/disgusting/culture/embarrassed/point/yard; afraid/scared/spider/snake/worry/nervous/trust/pay/fees; cry/shake/scream/shoulder/people/sports/comfort/money/buy

metadata.capsReference: Listening and Speaking: traditions, community, creativity, health, worry themes

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Mon/Wed/Fri: revision of sounds from Term 1; sp (spill/spell/spank/spunk/spit/spin/spot); sh- (ship/shop/shut/shed/shell/shack/shock/shall); -sh (wish/fish/cash/bush/push/wash/crash/trash); th (then/theft/they/think/thank/that/the); word families; -ch (chin/chop/check/chain/much/each); th (bath/cloth/with/mouth/maths/tooth/fifth/depth); sl/-ing/ (slash/slashing/slip/slipping/sling/slinging); -oo- (pool/fool/tool/drool/spoon/soon/moon/loon); ch- and -ed (rich/such/much/chatted/chipped/chopped/chilled/checked); Formal Assessment by Week 9

metadata.capsReference: Phonics: sp sh- -sh th -ch sl -oo- blends, formal assessment

nodes.title: Reading — Shared Reading
nodes.description: Shared Reading on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Cycle: Tue1 Pre-read → Thu1 First Read → Tue2 Second Read → Thu2 Post-reading activity. Learners make predictions, visualise, make inferences (good guesses), make connections

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared Reading Tue/Thu, predict, visualise, infer

nodes.title: Reading — Group Guided Reading
nodes.description: Group Guided Reading Mon-Fri daily: listen to one group per day. Revise groups if needed. 5 ability groups. Learners read aloud from own book with teacher; uses reading strategies (phonics, context clues, structural analysis, sight words); reads with increasing fluency and expression; shows understanding of punctuation; builds sight vocabulary

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Group Guided Reading — 5 groups, phonics/sight words/fluency

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Writing twice per week. Frames: I want to learn how to...just like my.../He/she is.../I am...; In my family we.../We do this because.../I like when.../I also like...; about a place in community they admire; I want to be like... I like.../I think he/she is...; Day 2: When I go there I.../I also...; Write message on card to thank community person; about persons in community they admire; a toy they would love to make; a future invention; fruits and vegetables I like to eat; My favourite healthy food; Dear.../I felt afraid of.../When I felt afraid.../Thank you for.../Love; I am worried about.../I am also worried about.../I don't need to worry because.../I will tell...

metadata.capsReference: Writing: community, creativity, healthy eating, worry themes; nouns/pronouns; spelling from dictation

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 2 English FAL Term 4 (47 days). Themes: Solving problems (Weeks 1-2), Historical figures (Weeks 3-4), Bullying and appearance (Weeks 5-6), Using technology for good (Weeks 7-8), Consolidation and Revision (Weeks 9-10)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 2 EFAL ATP Term 4

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Done on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays: greeting + song/rhyme + open-ended question + vocabulary. Songs with actions: problem-solving songs, marching songs for historical figures, anti-bullying song (SAY NO TO BULLIES), technology songs. Vocabulary: problem/solve/fix/important/confident/ruin/classroom/rip/gone; happy/happier/happiest/smile/listen/listener/front/back/sorry/respect; history/past/statue/famous/culture/celebrate/clothing/protect/fight; leader/meeting/fierce/powerful/trade/money/market/ancestor/strength; mirror/reflection/appearance/look/beautiful/pretty/ugly/call/dirty/clean/hole; speak/proud/tease/stop/small/skinny/big/size/fit/thin/fat/body; social media/post/video/photograph/Earth/plastic/internet/save/speech/convince/expert/climate; heat up/destroy/article/destroying/article/flyer/protest/rally/Facebook/Instagram/Twitter

metadata.capsReference: Listening and Speaking: problems, history, bullying, technology themes
assessmentStandards: L&S rubric 5pts — simple recount of 3-4 sentences

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Mon/Wed/Fri: fl- (fly/flash/flip/flap/flat); sl- (sly/slot/sling/slow/slab); cl- (cling/clap/cloth/clue/class); pl (plan/play/plum); br- (bring/brim/brown/break/brick); gr- (grow/grass/green/grab/gran/grid); -oo- (book/room/boot/foot/tooth/cook/cool); -ee (tree/bee/see/cheese/teeth/feet/greet/meet); Revision; Distinguish aurally between sounds that are often confused (e.g. ship/sheep); Formal Assessment Week 6; Word building with consonant and vowel digraphs

metadata.capsReference: Phonics: fl- sl- cl- pl br- gr- -oo- -ee, formal assessment
assessmentStandards: Phonics written 10pts — word with short vowels, group word families

nodes.title: Reading — Shared Reading
nodes.description: Shared Reading on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Cycle: Tue Pre-read → Thu First Read (search the text, recall details) → Tue Second Read (make evaluations) → Thu Post-read (oral recount). Learners listen to stories; answer literal questions; name objects in pictures; act out story using dialogue. Formal Assessment: oral reading passage 50-60 words (DBE Workbook or Reader) with multiple choice and cloze procedure questions

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared Reading Tue/Thu, evaluations, recall, formal assessment
assessmentStandards: Reading written comprehension 5pts — 50-60 words, multiple choice/cloze

nodes.title: Reading — Group Guided Reading
nodes.description: Group Guided Reading Mon-Fri daily (Week 1: establish whether learners are in correct reading group; Weeks 2-10: listen to one group per day). 5 ability groups. Formal Assessment: oral reading from own book (60-70 words) with 3 questions — by Week 9. Reads aloud using phonics, context clues, structural analysis, sight words; reads with fluency and expression; shows understanding of punctuation

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Group Guided Reading — 5 groups, formal oral assessment 60-70 words
assessmentStandards: Reading oral GGR checklist — 60-70 words, 3 questions

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Tuesdays and Thursdays. Frames: One time I felt angry because.../I solved the problem by.../I didn't work because...; In the story.../Zweli feels...; Things I know about history: 1./2.; I liked when.../I think Queen Amina is a role model because...; The bully said,'...'/He/She feels...; Practical using word cards: jumbled sentences; Practical using word cards in correct order; Organise information in simple graphic form (e.g. how many learners have a cell phone); Shared Writing: What are we going to do this holiday? Language structures: nouns/pronouns; simple present, present progressive and past tenses; plurals

metadata.capsReference: Writing: themed frames, jumbled sentences, graphic organiser, tenses
assessmentStandards: Writing 5pts — 3 sentences on familiar topic, capital letters, full stops
